caseStudy.problem: Workshop owners struggled with manual tracking of oil changes and inventory, leading to missed appointments and stock shortages.
caseStudy.approach: Built a unified platform with automated reminders, real-time stock tracking, and intelligent scheduling.

caseStudy.problem: Restaurant chains needed a unified system to manage orders, inventory, and reporting across multiple locations.
